# What a proposal-mode agent run's create_link stores in proposals.payload
# (refactor plan S9, invariant I16), reached by POST /api/v1/links.
# request: the DTO the handler decoded, as encoding/json writes it.
# stored payload: the map maybePropose builds from it, after the proposal
# service lifts a create_artifact's ref into its own column (keys sorted, as
# encoding/json writes a map; Postgres keeps it as JSONB).
# applied: the DTO the applier decodes from the stored payload on approval.
# A refactor never changes this file; for a deliberate change regenerate it
# with
#   UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./internal/api -count=1 -run '^(TestFormatsGolden|TestProposalPayloadsGolden)$'
dto: CreateLinkRequest
case "every field set":
  request: {"from_id":"5e9a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000107","to_id":"tmp-1","type":"verifies","attributes":{"note":"pending"}}
  stored payload: {"attributes":{"note":"pending"},"from_id":"5e9a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000107","to_id":"tmp-1","type":"verifies"}
  stored ref: ""
  stored target_id: null
  applied: {"from_id":"5e9a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000107","to_id":"tmp-1","type":"verifies","attributes":{"note":"pending"}}
case "zero value":
  request: {"from_id":"","to_id":"","type":"","attributes":null}
  stored payload: {"attributes":null,"from_id":"","to_id":"","type":""}
  stored ref: ""
  stored target_id: null
  applied: {"from_id":"","to_id":"","type":"","attributes":null}
